Cassie: opened PR to add export-redaction examples for audit logs and standardize example fields: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1510
Alex: good. are we renaming fields in examples?
Cassie: yes — use "pseudonymous_id" and explicit "tenant_id". also include a small HMAC-with-KMS-salt snippet and an allowlist pattern so routing keys are preserved.
Jordan: paste the Go snippet so I can copy it into runtime hooks.
Cassie: short example in PR:
```
// redact hashes tenant_id and removes free-text before export
func redact(evt map[string]interface{}, salt string) map[string]interface{} {
  if v, ok := evt["tenant_id"].(string); ok {
    mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(salt))
    mac.Write([]byte(v))
    evt["tenant_id"] = fmt.Sprintf("hmac:%x", mac.Sum(nil))
  }
  delete(evt, "raw_prompt")
  return evt
}
```
Maria: Legal asks we avoid "PII" in docs; use "sensitive identifiers" and show examples.
Lee (Compliance): Also do not redact routing keys (region, shard). Link to Audit Retention page instead of listing TTLs. Add a compliance sign-off checkbox on PR template.
Cassie: added checkbox, KMS comment, and TODO for a unit test. Docs-bot: PR referenced: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1510 — reviewers requested: @Lee (Compliance), @Alex
